subject: Request: outcome-driven customer reference to support upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: outcome-driven customer reference to support upcoming renewal

Team —

Quick context: FinBank (deal RJ-4421) is up for renewal 2026-06-01. They deployed Redwood Dedicated in production three months ago and the customer outcomes look strong in our dashboards: ~4x P95 latency improvement on their chat endpoints, ~40% reduction in per-token inference cost after moving to quantized variants and prefix caching, and CS has logged an NPS uplift in the cohort we rolled out.

We need a short customer reference + permission to use their logo to support the renewal upsell (we're proposing a multi-quarter committed capacity expansion). Ask:
- 15-minute reference call (recording optional)
- Approval of a 2–3 sentence testimonial we can use in sales collateral and the renewal deck
- Permission to feature FinBank logo on our site/case study

I attached a one-pager summarizing the measured outcomes and a testimonial template to make this quick. Vanessa / Marissa — can CS lead the call and handle the security questions? Aditya — I may need a small promotional credit ask approved if they want to expand (approx $8k one-time).

Preferred next steps: I can do the outreach today if we align on the ask and the quote draft.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Sounds good — happy to own the reference call. A couple of quick notes from CS/security perspective:
- They may ask for SOC 2 / encryption detail before approving public quote; have our SOC 2 evidence link ready.
- Avoid publishing revenue/ARR numbers — stick to performance and operational outcomes (latency, cost, developer time saved).
- Offer a quote approval process: we send a 2-line draft, they approve in email.

Plan: Priyom reaches out with the one-pager and draft quote; I'll loop in the FinBank technical lead on the call and take point on any security questions. Marissa — can you prepare the short case-study template (one A4) so we can turn this into a customer story fast if they say yes?

I can be on the call next Tue/Wed mornings.

-Vanessa

Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short reference and quote approval to support FinBank renewal (RJ-4421)

Hi Liam / Priya —

Hope you’re both well. I’m reaching because FinBank’s contract renewal is coming up (RJ-4421) and we wanted to ask for a short favor: would FinBank be willing to provide a brief reference or testimonial we can use in our renewal/expansion materials?

Why we’re asking: your team’s rollout is a great example of the real production improvements Redwood aims to deliver. From our measurement dashboards and CS feedback since launch, the deployment has seen:
- ~4x improvement in P95 inference latency on chat endpoints (typical peak workloads)
- ~40% lower inference cost per 1k tokens after quantization and prefix caching
- Improved developer iteration time thanks to consistent hosting and model variants

If you’re willing, two quick items would be extremely helpful:
1) A 15-minute call (we can keep it off-record) to capture a short quote or permission to use a 2–3 sentence testimonial
2) A quick email approval of a one or two-line quote and permission to use the FinBank logo in a customer story

I attached a one-pager summarizing the outcomes and a very brief draft quote to make this easy. If you prefer, Vanessa from our CS team will run the technical/security portion of the call.

Suggested times for a quick sync: Tue 5/12 or Wed 5/13 09:00–11:00 PT. If those don’t work, tell me a slot and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks for considering — your support here would directly help the contract conversation and allow us to showcase the results your team achieved (and secure some expansion capacity that will keep latency and cost predictable for you).

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Also, we’ll need to confirm there’s no customer data in any public excerpt.

We can do a 15-minute call next Tue 5/12 at 09:30 PT — that works for me. Priya and I will join. If you can send a draft quote today, we’ll look to approve by email after the call.
